dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly circular and elliptical 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-intensity, slightly diffuse light perimeters surrounding dark interiors; the transition from the dark dorsal background to the light ring is a high-contrast gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, irregular clusters of solid high-intensity pixels without internal dark gradients, primarily visible in the posterior and neck regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A triad of prominent annuli in the upper-mid section forms a non-equilateral triangle; a separate pair of annuli located ventrally to this triad forms a nearly horizontal linear relationship relative to the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced linear high-intensity features corresponding to vibrissae are visible near the snout against the dark background.
